beginning: 三段式布局示例：固定顶栏、动态主界面、底部按钮栏、原生顶栏拉片。

regex_scripts.replaceString: <script>(()=>{const q=(s,r=document)=>r.querySelector(s);const qa=(s,r=document)=>Array.from(r.querySelectorAll(s));const root=q('.app-shell');const top=q('.app-top',root);const main=q('.app-main',root);const modal=q('[data-app-modal]',root);const tabs=q('.app-tabs',root);const native=q('.topTabbar');const chat=q('.chat-body');q('.chat-bottom').appendChild(tabs);document.body.classList.add('app-ui-enabled');const layout=()=>{const topH=top.offsetHeight;const bottomH=tabs.offsetHeight;document.body.style.setProperty('--app-native-h',native.offsetHeight+'px');main.style.top=topH+'px';main.style.bottom=bottomH+'px';modal.style.top=topH+'px';modal.style.bottom=bottomH+'px';chat.style.setProperty('padding-top',topH+'px','important')};const setPage=page=>{modal.classList.remove('is-open');qa('[data-app-page]').forEach(tab=>tab.classList.toggle('is-active',tab.dataset.appPage===page));qa('[data-app-view]',root).forEach(view=>view.classList.toggle('is-active',view.dataset.appView===page));main.classList.toggle('is-active',page!=='a');layout()};qa('[data-app-page]').forEach(tab=>tab.addEventListener('click',e=>{e.stopPropagation();setPage(tab.dataset.appPage)}));q('[data-app-native-toggle]',root).addEventListener('click',e=>{e.stopPropagation();document.body.classList.toggle('app-native-open')});document.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(!document.body.classList.contains('app-native-open'))return;if(native.contains(e.target)||q('[data-app-native-toggle]',root).contains(e.target))return;document.body.classList.remove('app-native-open')});const ro=new ResizeObserver(layout);ro.observe(top);ro.observe(tabs);ro.observe(native);window.addEventListener('resize',layout);setPage('a')})();</script>
